description: Écouter des messages du contrôle et choisir ce qu'ils disent, puis noter les valeurs à collationner.

fiches.question: Easy two five, turn left heading two seven zero, descend flight level eight zero.
fiches.reponse: Turn left heading 270, descend to FL80.

fiches.question: Easy two five, turn right heading two seven zero, climb flight level one eight zero.
fiches.reponse: Turn right heading 270, climb to FL180.

fiches.question: Air France four five, reduce speed two one zero knots.
fiches.reponse: Slow down to 210 knots.

fiches.question: Air France four five, maintain two five zero knots or greater until four miles final.
fiches.reponse: Keep at least 250 knots until 4 miles from touchdown.

fiches.question: Speedbird one two, hold short runway two seven, landing traffic.
fiches.reponse: Wait before runway 27 because an aircraft is landing.

fiches.question: Speedbird one two, line up and wait runway two seven.
fiches.reponse: Enter runway 27 and wait for take-off clearance.

fiches.question: Lufthansa eight, proceed direct LUREN, then resume own navigation.
fiches.reponse: Fly straight to LUREN, then navigate on your own.

fiches.question: Lufthansa eight, contact Paris Control one two eight decimal one, good day.
fiches.reponse: Change frequency to Paris Control on 128.1.

fiches.question: Ryanair three alpha, expedite descent through flight level one five zero.
fiches.reponse: Descend quickly through FL150.

fiches.question: Ryanair three alpha, stop descent at flight level one six zero, traffic.
fiches.reponse: Level off at FL160 because of traffic.

fiches.question: Iberia seven, hold at TOU as published, expect further clearance at one five.
fiches.reponse: Enter the published hold at TOU; a new clearance should come at quarter past.

fiches.question: Iberia seven, cleared ILS approach runway three two left, report established.
fiches.reponse: You may fly the ILS for runway 32L; call when established.

fiches.question: KLM nine, go around, I say again go around, vehicle on the runway.
fiches.reponse: Abandon the landing because a vehicle is on the runway.

fiches.question: KLM nine, vacate left via Bravo three, contact Ground one two one decimal eight.
fiches.reponse: Leave the runway to the left at B3, then call Ground on 121.8.

fiches.question: Swiss two, give way to the Airbus crossing left to right, then taxi to holding point Alpha one.
fiches.reponse: Let the Airbus pass, then taxi to holding point A1.

fiches.question: Easy two five, traffic eleven o'clock, eight miles, opposite direction, one thousand feet above.
fiches.reponse: Traffic ahead slightly to the left, 8 miles, coming towards you, 1000 ft higher.

fiches.question: Easy two five, traffic two o'clock, five miles, crossing right to left, same level.
fiches.reponse: Traffic ahead to the right, 5 miles, crossing your path at your level.

fiches.question: Information Kilo, runway in use two six, wind two four zero degrees one five knots gusting two eight.
fiches.reponse: Runway 26 in use; wind from 240 at 15 knots with gusts to 28.

fiches.question: Visibility one thousand two hundred metres in mist, overcast two hundred feet.
fiches.reponse: Visibility 1200 m in mist, low cloud covering the sky at 200 ft.

fiches.question: Caution, braking action reported medium to poor on the second half of the runway.
fiches.reponse: The end of the runway is slippery.

fiches.question: Moderate turbulence reported between flight level three two zero and three six zero.
fiches.reponse: Turbulence has been reported between FL320 and FL360.

fiches.question: Expect a delay of about twenty minutes due to traffic.
fiches.reponse: You will probably wait around 20 minutes because of traffic.

fiches.question: The ILS for runway two seven is unserviceable, expect RNP approach.
fiches.reponse: The ILS is out of order; plan an RNP approach instead.

fiches.question: Wind shear reported on short final by a Boeing seven three seven.
fiches.reponse: A 737 met wind shear close to the runway.

fiches.question: Departures are suspended due to a thunderstorm overhead the field.
fiches.reponse: No take-offs for now because a storm is over the airport.

fiches.question: Easy two five, radar contact lost, report your level.
fiches.reponse: The controller no longer sees you on radar and needs your level.

fiches.question: Bird activity reported in the vicinity of the threshold of runway zero nine.
fiches.reponse: Birds have been seen near the start of runway 09.

fiches.question: Easy two five, due to a disabled aircraft the runway is closed, say intentions.
fiches.reponse: The runway is blocked by an aircraft; tell ATC what you want to do.

fiches.question: Easy two five, change of runway, now expect runway zero eight for landing.
fiches.reponse: You will now land on runway 08.

fiches.question: Easy two five, we have reports of a drone on the approach path, expect to hold.
fiches.reponse: A drone was seen on the approach; plan to hold.

fiches.question: Easy two five, smoke was seen from your left engine on departure, say intentions.
fiches.reponse: Smoke came from your left engine; tell ATC your plans.

fiches.question: Easy two five, emergency services are standing by, you are number one, cleared to land.
fiches.reponse: Fire services are ready, you land first and are cleared to land.

fiches.question: Easy two five, a medical team will meet the aircraft on stand twelve.
fiches.reponse: Doctors will be waiting at stand 12.

fiches.question: Easy two five, the airport closes in thirty minutes because of the curfew.
fiches.reponse: The airport will close for the night in 30 minutes.

fiches.question: Easy two five, confirm you are able to accept a landing distance of two thousand metres.
fiches.reponse: Check that 2000 m of runway is enough for you.

fiches.question: Easy two five, there is a strike at your destination, expect long delays on arrival.
fiches.reponse: There is a strike at your destination, so expect long waits.

fiches.question: Easy two five, after landing, a tow truck will take you to the maintenance area.
fiches.reponse: After landing, a tug will tow you to maintenance.

fiches.question: Easy two five, your transponder seems faulty, recycle squawk two three one four.
fiches.reponse: Reset the transponder code to 2314.

fiches.question: Easy two five, a passenger from your previous flight left a bag, the company asks you to call them.
fiches.reponse: Your company wants you to call about a bag left by a passenger.
